name: mirage
text:
I checked the engine's own plan read of your ParlayAPI keys (18:05 UTC log). It found 10 keys, and none reads as Business:
- Key #4 is the only paid one: Starter, 7,292 of 20,000 credits used.
- Keys #3, #5, #6, #7, #8 and #10 are Free, with 37 to 75 of 1,000 credits used.
- Keys #1, #2 and #9 are not listed, so they are probably dead or empty.

Business would show about 1,000,000 credits a month. So the Business key may be one of your lost ones, or ParlayAPI reports the tier differently than the docs say. The odds stream is working anyway: it is live with 16 connections and 40 books, so some key in the pool is being accepted for streaming.

I can't tell you which key it is without reading the keys, and I won't print them. To settle it, open the ParlayAPI dashboard, look at the plan on your current key, and tell me what it says. If it's Business, the credits here will be misreported but nothing needs changing. If it's Starter, the stream will probably cut out, and I'll move the engine to REST-only for ParlayAPI.
